content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Macon

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate, or equivalent) and completion of project management education hours. Crucially, no prior work experience is required—making CAPM ideal for career-changers and early-career professionals across Macon's aerospace, healthcare, manufacturing, and logistics sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. Our intensive format compresses the required contact hours into a focused schedule, letting you balance certification study with your current job or personal commitments while learning from active certified practitioners.

steps_items.heading: Submit PMI Application & Fee
steps_items.text: Register with the Project Management Institute and submit your application along with proof of your educational requirement. PMI will review and approve your candidacy before you schedule your exam. This step formally activates your pathway to the credential.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources and study materials to reinforce core project management concepts. Schedule your CAPM exam through Pearson VUE. Our instructors guide you through the exam format and question types to build confidence.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, maintain your CAPM through PMI's three-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units (PDUs). Continue learning through courses, conferences, or volunteer project work—keeping your credential current and strengthening your value in Macon's competitive job market.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
